ch04-c153.sql:
create schema scratch;
create view scratch.legacy_result as
SELECT C.COUNTRY, COUNT(DISTINCT X.ID) AS ORDERS, SUM(X.PAID)/100 AS REVENUE
FROM JAFFLE_SHOP.CUSTOMERS C, (
    SELECT O.ID, O.USER_ID,
        (SELECT SUM(P.AMOUNT) FROM STRIPE.PAYMENTS P
         WHERE P.ORDERID = O.ID AND P.STATUS = 'success') AS PAID
    FROM JAFFLE_SHOP.ORDERS O
    WHERE O.STATUS IN ('completed', 'shipped')) X
WHERE X.USER_ID = C.ID
AND C.ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM JAFFLE_SHOP.ORDERS WHERE STATUS = 'returned')
GROUP BY C.COUNTRY;
create view scratch.refactored_result as
with

-- import CTEs
customers as (
    select * from jaffle_shop.customers
),

orders as (
    select * from jaffle_shop.orders
),

payments as (
    select * from stripe.payments
),

-- logical CTEs
order_payments as (
    select
        orderid as order_id,
        sum(amount) as paid_cents
    from payments
    where status = 'success'
    group by orderid
),

customers_with_returns as (
    select distinct user_id as customer_id
    from orders
    where status = 'returned'
),

valid_orders as (
    select
        orders.id as order_id,
        orders.user_id as customer_id,
        order_payments.paid_cents
    from orders
    left join order_payments
        on orders.id = order_payments.order_id
    where orders.status in ('completed', 'shipped')
),

final as (
    select
        customers.country,
        count(distinct valid_orders.order_id) as orders,
        sum(valid_orders.paid_cents) / 100 as revenue
    from customers
    inner join valid_orders
        on customers.id = valid_orders.customer_id
    left join customers_with_returns
        on customers.id = customers_with_returns.customer_id
    where customers_with_returns.customer_id is null
    group by customers.country
)

select * from final;

select
    (select count(*) from scratch.legacy_result)     as legacy_rows,
    (select count(*) from scratch.refactored_result) as refactored_rows;

ch04-c157.sql:
with report as (
with

-- 1. import CTEs: one per raw table, only the columns we need
customers as (
    select
        id as customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name
    from jaffle_shop.customers
),

orders as (
    select
        id as order_id,
        user_id as customer_id,
        order_date
    from jaffle_shop.orders
),

payments as (
    select
        orderid as order_id,
        status,
        amount
    from stripe.payments
),

-- 2. logical CTEs: one business step each
order_payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount) as amount_cents
    from payments
    where status = 'success'
    group by order_id
),

customer_orders as (
    select
        customer_id,
        min(order_date) as first_order_date,
        max(order_date) as most_recent_order_date,
        count(order_id) as number_of_orders
    from orders
    group by customer_id
),

customer_payments as (
    select
        orders.customer_id,
        sum(order_payments.amount_cents) as lifetime_value_cents
    from orders
    inner join order_payments
        on orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id
    group by orders.customer_id
),

-- 3. final CTE: one row per customer
final as (
    select
        customers.customer_id,
        customers.first_name,
        customers.last_name,
        customer_orders.first_order_date,
        customer_orders.most_recent_order_date,
        coalesce(customer_orders.number_of_orders, 0) as number_of_orders,
        coalesce(customer_payments.lifetime_value_cents, 0) / 100
            as lifetime_value
    from customers
    left join customer_orders
        on customers.customer_id = customer_orders.customer_id
    left join customer_payments
        on customers.customer_id = customer_payments.customer_id
)

select * from final
)

select
    count(*) as n_customers,
    sum(number_of_orders) as total_orders,
    sum(lifetime_value) as total_lifetime_value,
    count(*) filter (where number_of_orders = 0) as customers_without_orders
from report;
